name: The Echoes of the Imperial Children's Names

game.core.world.fact.summary: The names Aldren, Evandor, Minevra, Valerian, Oberon, Rhiannon, Merceran, and Wayland belong to the early Thalmos royal dynasty. Their historical or mythological echoes are not canonically literal derivations; Thalmon named his children before their later specialties were known, though later historians and storytellers associate their names with their fields.
